Treatment Summary
The patient is a synthetic claimant presenting with lumbar strain following a collision sustained while the vehicle was
turning left, when the patient's vehicle was struck by another vehicle. The mechanism and force of impact are
consistent with the reported low back injury. Over the course of care, the patient attended 30 visits consisting of
physical therapy, manual therapy, home exercise instruction, and medication management. Early visits focused on
pain control and restoring range of motion, and frequency was reduced as function improved, consistent with a typical
recovery pattern. Examination revealed paraspinal muscle tenderness and reduced lumbar flexion that support the
diagnosis, while neurological screening and straight-leg raise testing were within normal limits. No prior injury to the
lumbar region is documented in the available history. Billing records reflect single charges for each service rendered
with no duplicated entries. At discharge the patient was improving and was advised to continue the home program as
needed.

address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
